candidates.name: Thin Node recorder in lib/karpathy that calls pk as an optional transport

evidence.claim: Upstream recorder is prometheus-skill-pack/skills/process/karpathy-progress-memory/scripts/record-progress.py (671 lines); it calls pk only at :411-416 and owns receipts, the lock, the 256 KiB bound (:278) and the secret rejection (:22-23, :279) itself.
This pack already has the primitives: lib/platform/lock.mjs, atomic-write.mjs, spawn.mjs spawnExecutable (shell:false, accepts input and timeout), text.mjs, lib/hooks/context.mjs degradeSafely.

risks: No Node dispatcher exists for KBD lifecycle boundaries (task:after etc.), so the recorder needs an explicit invocation point.
spawnExecutable resolving pk.exe through PATHEXT on Windows is untested in this pack.
PK_BIN (record-progress.py:402) is part of the contract and must be honoured, not only a PATH lookup.
canonical_validate needs prometheus kbd status --json for every event, so the prometheus CLI is an upstream prerequisite; its absence is undecided here.
candidates.decision_rationale: The goal that everything degrades when pk is absent decides it: receipts and idempotency must work with no pk, which is every clean machine while pk has 0 releases.

candidates.name: A pk record-progress subcommand upstream

evidence.claim: pk has 0 releases (gh release list --repo Prometheus-AGS/prometheus-knowledge-rs: 0 rows).
pk --help lists 15 subcommands; none records progress, so this is new Rust work plus a release before this pack could use it.

risks: Receipts and idempotency would disappear exactly when pk is missing.
Needs an upstream change requiring operator go-ahead.
candidates.decision_rationale: Fails the degrade goal by construction.

candidates.name: Sorted-key JSON with a Python float token for the single float field elapsedHours

evidence.claim: Observed on the golden receipt dea37563: naive Node hash ca79e321 DIFFERS from the recorded eventSha256 760d332e; re-emitting elapsedHours as 0.0 reproduces 760d332e exactly.

Hook replays compare eventIdentitySha256, not eventSha256 (prometheus-skill-pack/skills/process/karpathy-progress-memory/scripts/record-progress.py:571-576); its 8 fields hold no float, and the Node identity hash be2c1c52 already MATCHES.
elapsedHours is the only float-capable field and is bounded to 0-1000 (prometheus-skill-pack/skills/process/karpathy-progress-memory/scripts/record-progress.py:240-242).

risks: Verified against one receipt and only for an integer-valued float.
Python repr and JS toString also diverge below 1e-4; the spec should reject elapsedHours in (0, 1e-4) rather than guess.
candidates.decision_rationale: One rule on one named field closes the gap; a general canonicaliser solves a different problem.

candidates.name: canonicalize (RFC 8785 JCS)

evidence.claim: v5.1.0, modified 2026-09-18, 0 dependencies.

candidates.decision_rationale: RFC 8785 mandates ECMAScript number serialisation, so a conformant implementation must write 0; the recorded hashes were made from Python 0.0. It cannot reproduce them.

candidates.name: fs.appendFileSync under lib/platform/lock.mjs for session-log.md

evidence.claim: The recorder appends to .prometheus/session-log.md, marker-deduplicated under a lock (prometheus-skill-pack/skills/process/karpathy-progress-memory/scripts/record-progress.py:341-358); it never writes events.jsonl, which only pk-event-store writes (pk-event-store/src/fallback.rs:13).

risks: Upstream re-reads the whole log for the marker on every call; the receipt sessionLogAppended flag makes that unnecessary on a replay.
candidates.decision_rationale: No new primitive and no library: the append flag plus the existing wx lock is the whole mechanism.

candidates.name: Receipt-driven retry: complete:false + memory.status degraded, retried on replay

evidence.claim: pk ingest cannot succeed without a reachable LLM and has no raw mode (pk-librarian/src/librarian.rs:48-51; pk ingest --help shows only --kb-dir --source --scope --yes).

Upstream already retries the memory write from the receipt own event snapshot when the prior receipt is incomplete or degraded (prometheus-skill-pack/skills/process/karpathy-progress-memory/scripts/record-progress.py:586-600); degraded is emitted at :473.

Exit 0 for recorded, duplicate and degraded (record-progress.py:614, :626, :662); exit 2 for validation or I/O errors (:667). The receipt is written complete:false before the memory write and again after it; crash seams KPM_TEST_CRASH_BEFORE_MEMORY -> 74 and KPM_TEST_CRASH_AFTER_PK -> 75 (:636-648).

risks: A boundary that is never replayed is never retried.
The upstream outbox path is Python plus pk-learning-worker, neither of which this pack may run.
queued is never emitted here but must be READ: the golden receipt is complete:true with memory.status queued, so it replays as duplicate and its memory write is never retried.
candidates.decision_rationale: The receipt is already a durable queue of one; adopting it removes the need for an outbox, a drain, and a third daemon. Result states become recorded, duplicate, degraded.
